policy: Manually checked, dated primary-source and independent-secondary-source facts in short original wording; not a live automatic results collector. Original URLs stay in data. Preserve exact TV broadcast date. No article body redistribution.

programs.source_name: WWE AAA results / TPWW Oct 17 recap

results.text: Taurus defeated El Fiscal after interference from Abismo Negro Jr.
The Wagner Brothers defeated El Mesías and Mecha Wolf to retain the AAA World Tag Team Championship

developments.text: Abismo Negro Jr. helped Taurus beat El Fiscal, prompting a confrontation and a future match challenge
Flammer and La Hiedra argued while confronting AAA Reina de Reinas Champion La Catalina
Los Perros del Mal sparked a brawl with the Wagner Brothers and other AAA wrestlers after the tag title match
AAA revealed a Reina de Reinas triple threat with La Catalina, Flammer and La Hiedra for October 24
El Grande Americano and Dominik Mysterio were listed for the AAA Mega Championship match on October 24
Los Perros del Mal and the team of La Parka, Mr. Iguana and Niño Hamburguesa were listed for an October 24 trios title match

results.text: Indi Hartwell defeated Xia Brookside and retained the Knockouts World Championship
Cedric Alexander defeated Rich Swann, KC Navarro and Fabian Aichner
Jason Hotch defeated Mustafa Ali and retained the TNA International Championship
results.match_type: Two Out of Three Falls Championship Match

developments.text: Daria Rae ordered Indi Hartwell to defend her title immediately; Apex attacked Hartwell after her victory
The System assisted Cedric Alexander in earning an X-Division title opportunity against Amazing Red
Kiera Hogan and Tasha Steelz attacked Allie; Shotzi Blackheart intervened on Allie's behalf
Santino Marella announced two Ultimate X matches and the World X-Cup for Destination X
Leon Slater and Trey Miguel discussed their upcoming TNA World Championship match
syX challenged The Hardys ahead of the next iMPACT! episode
